WITH DEPARTMENT_TREE (ANCESTOR_DEPARTMENT_ID, DESCENDANT_DEPARTMENT_ID) AS ( SELECT DEPARTMENT_ID, DEPARTMENT_ID FROM POPUP.APP_DEPARTMENT UNION ALL SELECT t.ANCESTOR_DEPARTMENT_ID, child.DEPARTMENT_ID FROM DEPARTMENT_TREE t JOIN POPUP.APP_DEPARTMENT child ON child.PARENT_DEPARTMENT_ID = t.DESCENDANT_DEPARTMENT_ID ), SELECTED_USER AS ( SELECT u.* FROM POPUP.APP_USER u WHERE u.EMPLOYEE_NO = #{userId} AND u.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' ), CONDITION_RESULT AS ( SELECT n.POPUP_ID, g.TARGET_GROUP_ID, CASE c.CONDITION_TYPE WHEN 'DEPARTMENT' THEN CASE c.CONDITION_OPERATOR WHEN '=' THEN CASE WHEN c.INCLUDE_CHILD_YN = 'Y' THEN CASE WHEN EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DEPARTMENT_TREE t WHERE t.ANCESTOR_DEPARTMENT_ID = c.DEPARTMENT_ID AND t.DESCENDANT_DEPARTMENT_ID = u.DEPARTMENT_ID ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN u.DEPARTMENT_ID = c.DEPARTMENT_ID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END WHEN '!=' THEN CASE WHEN c.INCLUDE_CHILD_YN = 'Y' THEN CASE WHEN NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM DEPARTMENT_TREE t WHERE t.ANCESTOR_DEPARTMENT_ID = c.DEPARTMENT_ID AND t.DESCENDANT_DEPARTMENT_ID = u.DEPARTMENT_ID ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE CASE WHEN u.DEPARTMENT_ID <> c.DEPARTMENT_ID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END END ELSE 0 END WHEN 'POSITION' THEN CASE WHEN c.CONDITION_OPERATOR = '=' AND u.POSITION_ID = c.POSITION_ID THEN 1 WHEN c.CONDITION_OPERATOR = '!=' AND u.POSITION_ID <> c.POSITION_ID THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN 'EMPLOYEE' THEN CASE WHEN c.CONDITION_OPERATOR = '=' AND u.EMPLOYEE_NO = c.EMPLOYEE_NO THEN 1 WHEN c.CONDITION_OPERATOR = '!=' AND u.EMPLOYEE_NO <> c.EMPLOYEE_NO THEN 1 ELSE 0 END WHEN 'HIRE_DATE' THEN CASE WHEN c.CONDITION_OPERATOR = '=' AND u.HIRE_DATE = c.CONDITION_DATE_VALUE THEN 1 WHEN c.CONDITION_OPERATOR = '!=' AND u.HIRE_DATE <> c.CONDITION_DATE_VALUE THEN 1 WHEN c.CONDITION_OPERATOR = '<' AND u.HIRE_DATE < c.CONDITION_DATE_VALUE THEN 1 WHEN c.CONDITION_OPERATOR = '<=' AND u.HIRE_DATE <= c.CONDITION_DATE_VALUE THEN 1 WHEN c.CONDITION_OPERATOR = '>' AND u.HIRE_DATE > c.CONDITION_DATE_VALUE THEN 1 WHEN c.CONDITION_OPERATOR = '>=' AND u.HIRE_DATE >= c.CONDITION_DATE_VALUE THEN 1 ELSE 0 END ELSE 0 END AS CONDITION_MATCHED FROM SELECTED_USER u CROSS JOIN POPUP.POPUP_NOTICE n JOIN POPUP.POPUP_TARGET_GROUP g ON g.POPUP_ID = n.POPUP_ID JOIN POPUP.POPUP_TARGET_CONDITION c ON c.TARGET_GROUP_ID = g.TARGET_GROUP_ID WHERE n.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' AND BETWEEN n.DISPLAY_START_AT AND n.DISPLAY_END_AT AND ( n.QUESTION_TEMPLATE_ID IS NULL OR EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM POPUP.QUESTION_TEMPLATE t WHERE t.QUESTION_TEMPLATE_ID = n.QUESTION_TEMPLATE_ID AND t.ACTIVE_YN = 'Y' ) ) AND NOT EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM POPUP.USER_POPUP_STATUS s WHERE s.EMPLOYEE_NO = u.EMPLOYEE_NO AND s.POPUP_ID = n.POPUP_ID AND s.HIDDEN_UNTIL_AT > ) ), ELIGIBLE_POPUP AS ( SELECT POPUP_ID FROM CONDITION_RESULT GROUP BY POPUP_ID, TARGET_GROUP_ID HAVING MIN(CONDITION_MATCHED) = 1 ) SELECT
FROM ( SELECT DISTINCT POPUP_ID FROM ELIGIBLE_POPUP ) e JOIN POPUP.POPUP_NOTICE n ON n.POPUP_ID = e.POPUP_ID LEFT JOIN POPUP.POPUP_CONTENT ct ON ct.POPUP_ID = n.POPUP_ID ORDER BY n.DISPLAY_ORDER, n.CREATED_AT, n.POPUP_ID
